description: Add a single wall between two points on a level, straight or, with curveOffset, an arc. type applies a preset or project wall assembly including its thickness (unknown_wall_type for an unknown id). wallType railing builds the Build panel guard: default post-and-rail, 0.9144 m high, thickness from railing.postSize, no assembly or foundation. Its doors are gaps; windows refuse railing_window, skirting refuses railing_wall. railing settings on a standard wall refuse not_a_railing; type on a railing refuses railing_wall. Refused with a code: a level that is not a storey (a declared roof level), and a wall shorter than 1 cm. On a level below grade, a standard wall against the ground (on the outline of the walls of the level) is a foundation wall, built of what the building's region says: 8 in CMU with 2x4 pressure-treated furring laid flat inside (0.241 m) in the United States and where the scene does not say where the building stands, 25 cm cast concrete insulated and waterproofed outside (0.354 m) in Europe; the result names the region it read; a partition inside the outline is an ordinary wall; the result says which.

curveOffset.description: Bends the wall into an arc: the sagitta, from the middle of the straight line start→end to the middle of the arc. Positive bows the middle toward the back face (the −normal side, normal (−Δz, Δx) of start→end), the arc's centre on the front side; negative the other way. At most half the chord (a half circle); more is clamped. A quarter round of radius r at a corner: end both walls r short of the corner and join their ends with an arc of curveOffset ±0.293·r, the sign that bows it outward. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft").

end.description: [x, z] end point in level coordinates (metres).

height.description: Wall height (default: the storey's height; a railing 0.9144 m / 36 in). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

levelId.description: The level, by an id list_levels returned; an id made up from a name ("level_1", "level_ground") does not exist. Default: the floor the person is viewing, else the lowest floor.

railing.description: Railing settings, only with wallType railing. All lengths in metres; omitted fields follow the selected style.

bottomClearance.description: Clearance over the floor. Default 0.0889 m post-and-rail/boards, 0.05715 m balusters, 0.06985 m cable, 0.0762 m glass/metal. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Minimum 0 m.

cap.description: 2x6 top cap on post-and-rail/boards styles (default true).

infillGap.description: Clear infill gap. Default 0.0889 m wood styles, 0.066675 m cable, 0 m glass, 0.09525 m metal. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Minimum 0 m.

infillSize.description: Baluster/bar square side, cable diameter, board face height or glass thickness. Default by style: post-and-rail 0.0381, balusters 0.03175, cable 0.009525, boards 0.1397, glass 0.0127, metal 0.015875 m. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

postSize.description: Square post side; sets wall thickness, overriding thickness. Default 0.0889 m for wood styles, 0.0508 m cable, 0.0381 m glass/metal. In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

postSpacing.description: Maximum post spacing on centre (default 1.8288 m). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

style.description: Guard style (default post-and-rail); omitted member sizes use the style defaults from the Build panel.

start.description: [x, z] start point in level coordinates (metres).

thickness.description: Wall thickness (default 0.1 m; a wall against the ground on a level below grade, given none, is a foundation wall built of what the building's region says: 8 in CMU with 2x4 pressure-treated furring laid flat inside (0.241 m) in the United States and where the scene does not say where the building stands, 25 cm cast concrete insulated and waterproofed outside (0.354 m) in Europe; the result names the region it read; a partition inside it is an ordinary wall). In metres, or text with a unit ("6 ft"). Must be greater than 0 m.

type.description: Assembly type id from get_walls.wallTypes: a built-in preset or custom- project wall type. Copies its layers and total thickness in metres, overriding thickness. Unknown ids: unknown_wall_type.

wallType.description: Wall kind (default standard). railing is an open guard with its own height and post-derived thickness.

name: add_wall
title: Add wall
